reviewer_statement: Developer review of source-supported native-language semantics for fpca_spectrum_uncertainty_reporting_text; 32 direct full-string comparisons use actual frozen Python 1.2 typed result objects, 2 provenance/scope variants and 4 precision values across 4 exports. The related R scientific result is checked for required fields. Python dataclass/error class identities remain language-specific, and exact-head CI and external certification are not yet complete.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python typed frozen scientific dataclasses map to checked native R S3 scientific records. The returned Python str maps to a single native R character value. Published scientific descriptions, precision, component medians, interval caveats and source repr of apostrophe/Unicode provenance labels are compared without a Python dependency in native R.

case_evidence.description: Exact frozen reporting.py function and typed Python dataclass access; matching R exported signature and precision argument.
Two native-valid complete result metadata cases including family and component scope, optional near-tie gap screening and Python repr for apostrophe and Unicode labels.
32 frozen Python 1.2 typed source outputs agree exactly character-for-character with the native R reporting strings at digits 0,2,3,5.
Native R rejects absent or inconsistent scientific result matrices, invalid confidence and scope, nonfinite similarities and invalid digit precision; Python exception class identity is not claimed.
Exactly one ordered plain-text manuscript string per scientific result; no fitted estimator or graphics side effects.
bootstrap-matched eigenvalue and explained variance ratios with per-metric studentized familywise or componentwise intervals

independent_review_status: Developer source-semantic review only. Exact-head Linux Windows macOS and pinned Python 1.2 CI pending; independent reviewer certification remains zero.
